Name: Sprinkler Mod
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This mod lets you change the radii of vanilla sprinklers and lets non-sprinkler objects function as sprinklers by giving them radii as well.

It also lets you manually activate all sprinklers in the current location by pressing a hot key (default [b]Enter[/b]), or individually by hovering over the sprinkler and pressing a hot key (default [b]Right Mouse[/b]).

This mod is compatible with the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15239]Immersive Sprinklers[/url].

An example of a content pack that uses this mod to add custom sprinkler objects is [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15412/]Scarecrows As Sprinklers[/url].


[size=5][b]Custom Radii[/b][/size]

There are two ways to set a custom radius:

[list=1]
[*]Edit the mod's config.json file, which has radii for the three vanilla sprinklers in it. Change the number to whatever whole number you like. You can also add a new entry for a custom sprinkler object.

[*]Create a Content Pack targeting the dictionary at [b]aedenthorn.SprinklerMod/dictionary[/b]. The dictionary has the same format as the config file dictionary.
[/list]
Sprinklers with radius of 0 function like the ordinary vanilla sprinkler, with four water animations; all higher radii result in the single circular water animation.
For objects in [b]BigCraftableInformation[/b], you can specify the index instead of the name, e.g.:

[b]"Solid Gold Lewis": 5[/b]

or

[b]"164": 5[/b]


[size=5][b]Config[/b]
[/size]
You can customize this mod by editing the config file or using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].


[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url].

Implements a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] interface to change config settings in-game.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6338]Mod Updater[/url]﻿ for automatic updates.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].
